== Ingredients ==
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] brewed [[Cookbook:Coffee#Espresso|espresso]], cooled
* ⅓ cup granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] chocolate syrup
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] of [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 2 cups [[Cookbook:Heavy Cream|heavy cream]], [[Cookbook:Whipping|whipped]] to soft peaks

== Procedure ==
#Combine espresso, sugar, chocolate, salt, and chocolate syrup.
#Gently fold in the whipped cream.
#Chill for 20 minutes; serve.
